CREATE TABLE users (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kelompok',
      desa_id INTEGER REFERENCES desa(id),
      kelompok_id INTEGER REFERENCES kelompok(id),
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    , generus_id TEXT REFERENCES generus(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE users_old (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generus',
        desa_id INTEGER,
        kelompok_id INTEGER,
        generus_id TEXT,
        created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
      )
